Internal helper: the codes a declaration offered on a text variable names

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_text_declare_args.Rd

The codes = argument – with labels = where some values carry a label and others do not – of a line that declares values on a text variable together with the values it already declares (Jeff, Session 373): a declaration replaces a variable's values, so a line naming only the new ones would drop the others. Used by jdeclare_missing()'s note on values that differ from a declared one only in case or outer spaces, the load scan and jconvert()'s Pattern A report. A value keeps the label the variable gives it; a new value with none of its own takes the label of the declared value it differs from only in case or outer spaces. Every value labelled: named codes; none: bare codes; some: bare codes and labels =, as the S372 lines on numbers give them (.jst_labels_arg()).

Usage

.jst_text_declare_args(col, add, add_labels = NULL)

Arguments

col

The variable as it stands (character, or character-backed haven_labelled_spss).

add

The values to declare beside the declared ones.

add_labels

Labels for add (placeholders), or NULL for the variable's own.

Value

A list: arg, the argument text, or NULL past three values (a text variable's limit) or where a labels string cannot hold a value or a label; n, the number of values the line would name; add_labels, the labels the new values take ("" none).
